study_title: v1.90 VAR Residual Dependence Attribution Research
research_type: attribution / specification-diagnostic study; not a diagnostic-selection study
primary_question: What residual dependence patterns are present in the five formal estimable VARs, and what classes of model misspecification could plausibly generate them?

known: v1.88 per-unit production selected lags, asymptotic h=12 Portmanteau p-values, ELI and Phase B bootstrap p-values
v1.85/v1.89 finding that the asymptotic Portmanteau over-rejects (~21%) with month dummies at the correct lag
known_information_disclosure.not_yet_computed: no residual ACF, cross-lag, attribution, seasonal, variance, period or probe output of v1.90 has been computed or inspected

equation_acf.definition: r_k = sum_t (e_t - ebar)(e_{t-k} - ebar) / sum_t (e_t - ebar)^2 per equation

ljung_box.definition: n(n+2) sum_{k<=m} r_k^2/(n-k), descriptive chi-square(m) p-value
ljung_box.role: descriptive decomposition only; never a gate

cross_lag.definition: corr(e_i,t, e_j,t-k) = C_k[i,j]/sqrt(C_0[i,i] C_0[j,j]) with C_k = sum_t e_t e_{t-k}'/n, for all ordered pairs i != j

portmanteau_attribution.statistic: production adjusted Portmanteau Q*_h = n^2 sum_{k=1..h} tr(C_k' C_0^-1 C_k C_0^-1)/(n-k), h=12 (must equal the production portmanteauTest statistic to 1e-8)
portmanteau_attribution.exact_decomposition: with the symmetric square root W = C_0^{-1/2} (ordering-invariant) and R_k = W C_k W: tr(C_k' C_0^-1 C_k C_0^-1) = sum_{i,j} R_k[i,j]^2, so Q*_h = sum_k sum_{i,j} n^2 R_k[i,j]^2/(n-k) exactly
reported: concentration: top-3-lag share and Herfindahl index across lags
portmanteau_attribution.note: no trimmed or reweighted Portmanteau statistic is constructed

seasonal.seasonal_mean_vs_dynamic: seasonal mean effects: residual month-of-year means and a descriptive F statistic for equal month means (exactly zero by construction for v2 models with month dummies); seasonal dynamic dependence: own and cross correlations at lags 12 and 24 and the lag-12 share of Q*_12
seasonal.support_note: lag 24 reported for all units (n >= 135); flagged 'low support' is not needed because n - 24 >= 111

variance_stability.rolling_variance: 24-month rolling residual variance per equation; max/min ratio
variance_stability.arch_lm: Engle LM n*R^2 from regressing e_t^2 on its lags, q in {4,12}, descriptive chi-square(q) p-value
variance_stability.covariance_by_period: residual covariance per period P1/P2/P3; log det ratios and per-equation variance ratios relative to full sample

per_period: share of summed squared standardized residuals per equation
share of summed squared Mahalanobis residuals (full-sample C_0)

period-restricted whitened lag products: share of sum_k sum_ij n^2 R_k[i,j]^2/(n-k) mass using only products with t in the period (reported as descriptive shares; cross terms make shares approximate, documented)
period_concentration.causal_boundary: large residuals near dated events are not interpreted as causal explanations

sensitivity_probes.label: diagnostic-only attribution probes; never baselines, never readiness, never IRFs
sensitivity_probes.A_plus_one_lag: production selected lag + 1 ordinary lag, full effective sample
sensitivity_probes.B_seasonal_lag_term: production model + the lag-12 block y_{t-12} of all variables (sample starts where lag 12 is available)
sensitivity_probes.C_stable_subsample: production lag estimated on P1 only (first residual month .. 2019-12)
reported_per_probe: Q*_12 with components (lag shares, own/cross shares, lag-12 share)
change versus production for each component
sensitivity_probes.no_other_probes: no search over lag combinations; exactly these three probes

multiplicity_reporting.policy: every metric is reported for every unit, equation, lag and pair; descriptive p-values are accompanied by Benjamini-Hochberg q-values within each metric family (Ljung-Box, ARCH-LM, cross-lag at k=1..12,24 via Fisher z approximation)

labels_computed_on_production_model.little_residual_dependence: production asymptotic Portmanteau p >= 0.10 AND no equation Ljung-Box(12) BH q-value < 0.05
labels_computed_on_production_model.short_lag_own_equation_dependence: own-equation share of Q*_12 >= 0.50 AND lags 1-3 share >= 0.40
labels_computed_on_production_model.variance_instability_dominated: any equation ARCH-LM(12) BH q-value < 0.05 AND that equation's rolling-variance max/min ratio >= 4
labels_computed_on_production_model.break_outlier_concentrated: P2 share of squared Mahalanobis mass >= 2 x P2 observation share, OR >= 50% of |standardized residual| > 3 events in P2
labels_computed_on_production_model.diffuse_unexplained_dependence: none of the other labels except possibly break_outlier_concentrated applies, AND top-3-lag share < 0.40

attribution_rules.role: descriptive labels only, not readiness gates

platform_questions.Q1_test_calibration_issue: answered descriptively from (i) v1.85/v1.89 calibration evidence and (ii) units whose labels are little_residual_dependence or diffuse_unexplained_dependence with no probe reducing Q*_12 by >= 30%
platform_questions.Q2_genuine_misspecification: evidence counted when a unit's label is short_lag_own_equation, cross_equation_lag or seasonal_dynamic AND probe A or B reduces Q*_12 by >= 30% relative to production
platform_questions.Q3_justified_future_extension: named descriptively from the most frequent misspecification-consistent label (e.g. seasonal lag terms, higher-order or cross-lag structure, heteroskedasticity-robust inference, break-aware samples); never authorized in v1.90

interpretation_boundaries: no new pass/fail diagnostic; descriptive p-values are not gates
probes are diagnostic-only fits, not specifications
no deletion or winsorisation of observations
events near large residuals are not causal explanations
production_change_authorized = false; readiness_changed = false; formal_irf_publication_available = false
failure_handling: if production agreement fails or a probe is not estimable (singular or insufficient observations), the item is reported as unavailable with its reason; no substitute specification
stopping_rule: run once for the five units after explicit owner approval; stop after the attribution report
